title: One More
short: Each counting number is one more than the number before it.

blocks.html: When you count, each new number means one more thing.

blocks.name: tenframe
blocks.cap: There are 5 counters. Add one more. What number is that?

blocks.html: One more is the next counting number. 1 more than 5 is 6.
Counting adds one thing each time you say a number. So the number after 5 means a group of 5 with one more added.

blocks.name: k-pic
blocks.cap: One hop from 5 lands on 6: the next number is one more.

blocks.title: One more car
blocks.q: Sam has 4 cars. He gets 1 more. How many cars does he have now?
steps: One more is the next number: 4, 5.

blocks.html: For grown-ups: Ask “What is one more than 7?” with steps, snacks or toys. Let your child check by adding one and counting.

sources.name: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics, Kindergarten, K.CC.B.4c: each successive number name refers to a quantity that is one larger
Institute of Education Sciences practice guide: Teaching Math to Young Children (NCEE 2014-4005)
